title: Λ-EG — Emergent Gravitational Coherence: Theory, Ontology, Cosmology (T.O.C.)
description: Canonical consolidated record of the Λ-EG (Lambda Emergent Gravity) programme by J. Pablo Figueroa Torres. Includes: the covariant scalar-tensor emergent-gravity framework (v9: the v8 reviewer-response corrections, plus an explicitly declared assumption -- the redshift scaling g_crit(z) proportional to H(z) is the instantaneous-de Sitter reading of the spectral derivation, the identity R=12H^2 being exact only in de Sitter, with the covariant alternative and its numerical consequences stated); the confrontation with JADES DR4 high-redshift data; and the geometric mu-theorem (the standard MOND interpolating function mu(x)=x/sqrt(1+x^2) as the isotropic distribution of cot theta), now extended with a general exclusion criterion for interpolating functions (the Tully-Fisher flow is analytic at its fixed point if and only if the quadratic Taylor coefficient c2 vanishes; functions with c2 nonzero have a non-Lipschitz flow and predict a bimodal Tully-Fisher relation). Consolidates earlier scattered Zenodo records into a single citable lineage. Cosmology (CMB/FLRW) and ontology sections are forthcoming in future versions of this record.
